about: Modwerk source-only pipo-loop package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/pipo-loop.

mods.title: Pipo Loop
mods.summary: LOP gets a third value, PIPO: the sample's loop plays forward, then backward (ping-pong). FUNC + turn on STA or END steps to the next zero crossing.
